subject: Temporary exception for EU request logs — FinTechPro
messages:
From: Paul Chang <paul.chang@fintechpro.com>
To: jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: security_ops@fintechpro.com
Date: Tue, 03 Nov 2026 09:18:10 -0500
Subject: Request: brief extension to EU retention for debugging

Hi Jonas,

We ran into a regression in our payment reconciliation flow after a deployment last night. Our engineers need a short window to pull a targeted request/log snapshot for a set of session ids tied to a handful of failed transactions so we can reproduce and patch.

Specifically: can Redwood hold the request logs and associated metadata for the following session ids for an additional 48 hours beyond our configured EU retention (only the entries matching the session ids and timestamps below)? We want a timeboxed, narrow-scope snapshot — not a blanket retention change.

Session IDs: sess-328A, sess-328B, sess-330F
Time window: 2026-11-02 22:30 -> 2026-11-03 02:15 UTC
Requested extension: +48 hours
Region: eu-west-1 (GDPR scope)

Our compliance team is requesting a short written approval from Redwood that the data will be used only for debugging, will be encrypted in transit and at rest, and will be deleted immediately after we confirm the fix. I attached a short support snapshot request form for your internal reviewers.

Thanks — really appreciate a quick confirmation so we can keep our patch schedule.

Paul Chang
Head of Platform Engineering, FinTechPro
paul.chang@fintechpro.com
Attachment: support_snapshot_request.pdf (form)

From: jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Paul Chang <paul.chang@fintechpro.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Nov 2026 10:02:45 -0500
Subject: Re: Request: brief extension to EU retention for debugging

Paul — thanks for the note and the form. I’m looping in Security (Vivek) and Account Lead (Marissa) so we can evaluate the request and get you a timeboxed answer today.

High-level plan:
- Security to confirm technical feasibility and the minimum window required.
- Legal/compliance sign-off via a short exception form (we’ll send back an approval doc).
- If approved, we’ll create a targeted snapshot (read-only) and provide a short-lived link for your engineers; we will record audit logs and delete the snapshot on confirmation.

I’ve filed an internal ticket for tracking: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-8962 — tagging Security + Operations.

Jonas Weber
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com

From: vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 03 Nov 2026 11:25:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Request: brief extension to EU retention for debugging

Team — quick feasibility note from Security/Platform side. TL;DR: we can do a narrow, auditable snapshot for the specified session ids in eu-west-1, but with conditions.

Technical details and constraints:
- We will capture only entries matching the supplied session ids + time window; no other customer data will be touched.
- Snapshot will be encrypted with customer-key management (CMEK) where configured; if FinTechPro needs CMEK confirmed, we require their KMS key id in the approval form.
- Best-practice minimum window: 36 hours. 48 hours is possible but increases exposure surface; recommend 36h.
- We will attach an audit entry and an immutable deletion record once snapshot is destroyed.
- We will not change global retention settings; this is a one-off, targeted exception implemented as an access-limited snapshot.

Attachments: retention_change_playbook.md (internal runbook)

Action items for Marissa / Legal: can you confirm we have the OK to issue the exception with the 36-hour window and get the signed form back? I can schedule the snapshot as soon as we have the signed approval and the KMS key if needed.

Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Security, Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com

Date: Tue, 03 Nov 2026 14:08:13 -0500
Subject: Re: Request: brief extension to EU retention for debugging

Paul — thanks for the quick details and for being explicit about scope. We reviewed this with Security and Legal and we can approve a one‑off, timeboxed exception under the conditions below.

Approved exception (summary):
- Scope: only the session ids and time window you listed (sess-328A, sess-328B, sess-330F; 2026-11-02 22:30 -> 2026-11-03 02:15 UTC). No other records.
- Region: eu-west-1 only.
- Duration: 36 hours from the time the snapshot is created.
- Requirements from FinTechPro: signed exception_approval_form (DocuSign link below) and, if you require customer-managed encryption, the KMS key identifier.
- Audit: Redwood will emit an immutable audit record and a deletion confirmation once the snapshot is destroyed. We will not modify global retention policy.

Next steps:
1) Please review and sign here: https://docusign.com/fintechpro-exception-12345
2) Confirm KMS key id if you need CMEK (reply to this thread).
3) Once we have the signed form, we’ll create the snapshot and share a short‑lived view link: https://storage.redwood.com/snapshots/view/fintechpro-20261103

Attachments: exception_approval_form.pdf; deletion_confirmation_template.txt

If that works, I’ll schedule the snapshot at 15:00 UTC and set the 36-hour TTL. If you prefer a different time, let me know within the hour.

Marissa Cole
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
